description: A full-stack recipe sharing platform where users can create, discover, save, and manage recipes with authentication and responsive UI.
challenges: Implementing a secure and smooth authentication flow with Better Auth across protected and public routes.
Designing MongoDB schemas that efficiently support recipe creation, favorites, and search/filtering at scale.
Keeping the UI responsive and performant across a wide range of screen sizes.
futurePlans: Introduce a premium subscription tier with exclusive recipe collections.
Add role-based access control for content moderation.
Integrate a rating and review system for recipes.

description: A sports facility booking platform where users can reserve courts and owners can manage facilities with secure authentication.
challenges: Building a booking system that prevents double-booking of the same court/time slot.
Separating permissions cleanly between regular users and facility owners.
Handling real-time availability updates without overcomplicating the data layer.
futurePlans: Add online payment integration for bookings.
Add email/SMS booking reminders and confirmations.

description: An online livestock marketplace where users can browse, book, and purchase certified Qurbani animals with doorstep delivery.
challenges: Designing a clear, trustworthy browsing/filtering experience for livestock listings.
Structuring delivery and booking logic without a dedicated backend for this build.
futurePlans: Add a proper backend with order tracking and delivery status updates.
Introduce seller verification badges for trust and safety.

description: A friendship management application that helps users organize relationships, set reminders, and visualize communication habits.
challenges: Designing meaningful chart visualizations of communication habits using Recharts.
Building a reminder system that stays intuitive as the number of contacts grows.
futurePlans: Add push/email notifications for upcoming reminders.
Sync with device contacts for faster setup.
Add a shared/collaborative mode for managing group relationships.
